Log-prior for the joint two-acid age calibration

Source: R/age_calibration.R
log_prior_age_calibration.Rd

Weakly informative priors centred on literature-scale values (Kaufman et al. 2013-type Np calibrations), wide enough that a calibration dataset of ~100+ samples dominates the posterior.

Usage

log_prior_age_calibration(
  log_a_Asp,
  e_Asp,
  log_sigma_Asp,
  log_a_Glu,
  e_Glu,
  log_sigma_Glu,
  z_rho
)

Arguments

log_a_Asp, e_Asp, log_sigma_Asp

TDK (Asp) calibration parameters: log scale factor, exponent, log residual SD (log-age scale).

log_a_Glu, e_Glu, log_sigma_Glu

SPK (Glu) calibration parameters.

z_rho

Fisher-z transform of the residual correlation (\(\rho = \tanh(z_\rho)\)).

Value

Scalar log-prior.
